title: helianthemum ovatum subsp. glabrum

It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum ovatum subsp. glabrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
